statement: Arbitrary products mixing strict henselizations and effective non-Noetherian local flat unions have literal bounded canonical WG coordinates and all coordinatewise operations
notes: Symmetric determinant bits are omitted in algebraically closed residue. Exact simultaneous minimum ranks and degrees characterize the product image; local cancellation and fixed idempotent/coaction/Gram matrices prove injectivity and surjectivity. No finite global equality or boundedness algorithm for infinite families is claimed.
